Senior Backend Platform Engineer

We are building a cloud compute platform that powers critical customer workflows. This role focuses on distributed backend systems, deployment automation, cloud infrastructure reliability, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement resilient backend services and APIs.
- Improve deployment automation and release reliability.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and operational tooling.
- Support on-call operations and incident response improvements.
- Partner cross-functionally with product, SRE, and platform teams.

Preferred experience:
- Java / Spring Boot, event-driven systems, messaging.
- AWS cloud services and operational reliability.
- Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, and infrastructure automation.
- Strong debugging, observability, and systems thinking.
